'''Octopi''' (singular '''octopus''') were [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopods]] with eight tentacles.

==Overview==
At least one [[Species/Legends|species]] of octopus was native to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] once got one stuck to his head.<ref name="GRB" />

[[Arboreal octopus/Legends|Arboreal octopi]] were native to [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]];<ref name="AOTCVD" /> [[Orion Ferret]] had a pet which might have belonged to this species. [[Dhol]] of [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]] belonged to a race of [[Sentience/Legends|sapient]] octopi. The [[Twenchok/Legends|twenchok]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] resembled octopi.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
